oneOf.description: Options for advanced users. You should not typically need to modify these.

feature_flags.description: This property is intended for Estuary internal use. You should only modify this field as directed by Estuary support.
feature_flags.title: Feature Flags

nanosecond_timestamps.description: Use nanosecond precision (Iceberg format v3) for date-time columns instead of microsecond precision (format v2). Toggling this on an existing materialization applies to data going forward: existing rows read as null for converted columns unless the binding is explicitly backfilled.
nanosecond_timestamps.title: Nanosecond Timestamps

variant_columns.description: Use the Iceberg variant column type (format v3) for object/array/multi-type fields and the root document instead of JSON strings. Toggling this on an existing materialization applies to data going forward: existing rows read as null for converted columns unless the binding is explicitly backfilled.
variant_columns.title: Variant Columns

oneOf.title: Advanced Options

aws_access_key_id.description: Access Key ID for accessing AWS services (legacy).
aws_access_key_id.title: AWS Access Key ID

aws_secret_access_key.description: Secret Access Key for accessing AWS services (legacy).
aws_secret_access_key.title: AWS Secret Access Key

bucket.description: The S3 bucket to write data files to.
bucket.title: Bucket

credential.description: Credential for connecting to the catalog.
credential.title: Credential

scope.description: Desired scope of the requested security token.
scope.title: Scope

token.description: Token for connecting to the catalog.
token.title: Token

uri.description: URI identifying the REST catalog. Format: 'https://yourserver.com/catalog'.
uri.title: URI

glue_id.description: Glue Catalog ID to use. Defaults to the account ID of the configured credentials when not set.
glue_id.title: Glue Catalog ID

awsAccessKeyId.description: Access Key ID for writing data to the bucket.
awsAccessKeyId.title: AWS Access Key ID

awsSecretAccessKey.description: Secret Access Key for writing data to the bucket.
awsSecretAccessKey.title: AWS Secret Access key

aws_role_arn.description: AWS Role which has access to the resource which will be assumed by Flow
aws_role_arn.title: AWS Role ARN

namespace.description: Namespace for bound collection tables (unless overridden within the binding resource configuration).
namespace.title: Namespace

prefix.description: Optional prefix that will be used to store objects.
prefix.title: Prefix

s3_endpoint.description: Custom S3 endpoint URL. The default AWS S3 endpoint for the specified region is used if not provided.
s3_endpoint.title: S3 Endpoint

upload_interval.description: Frequency at which files will be uploaded. Must be a valid ISO8601 duration string no greater than 4 hours.
upload_interval.title: Upload Interval

additional_table_properties.description: Additional Iceberg table properties to set when the table is created. These are set only at creation time and cannot be changed afterwards. Example: {'write.parquet.compression-codec': 'zstd'}
additional_table_properties.title: Additional Table Properties

delta_updates.description: Should updates to this table be done via delta updates. Currently this connector only supports delta updates.
delta_updates.title: Delta Update
